name: Spectral Archer
description: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is vulnerable.

abilities.name: Ghost
abilities.description: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

abilities.name: Pick Your Target
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack within Far range against a PC who is within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes 2d8+12 physical damage.
